Complete 25-channel preset objectives decrease on ligand, connected beta-amino acid, D-peptide, modified-DNA, metal and mixed-batch fixtures with exact frozen-atom and unchanged-input invariants in Torch CPU and JAX CPU. CUDA complete-preset minimization validation is pending; earlier reduced objectives pass CPU/CUDA.

Shared palette, geometry, retained-atom plans, task/request preparation and native DOF assembly. Dunbrack/explicit amino-acid chi and input/fallback coordinates support custom chemistry; six frontend CPU/CUDA comparisons have exact coordinates/identities. Internal CPU/CUDA sparse topology, retention and candidate stages are tested; CPU annealing matches mature seeded molecular calls. Sparse LJ/LK and electrostatic values/coordinate VJPs pass CPU science, custom parameters and jit/vmap; CUDA scoring validation pending. No complete interaction-graph scoring or packing/design/mutation/FastRelax frontend, CUDA annealer, optH/conjugated/NA samplers, or sparse forward-mode/higher derivatives. Task APIs remain a subset.

PoseStackKinematics shares chemical spanning, residue stencils, complete native pose assembly and inverse/forward scans with Torch. Independent preparation covers ligand, noncanonical/D, nucleic-acid, metal and mixed inputs; CPU metadata/coordinates/full DOF gradients match Torch exactly. Six-column maps fix reference rotations and support first reverse derivatives, jit and vmap; matching installed Torch-free package passes. CUDA eager/compiled placement passes; all ten same-state float64 molecular gradient comparisons agree within 1.5e-11. Float32 DNA rotational gradients show cancellation, still under investigation. Empty poses, inverse-coordinate AD, forward-mode and higher derivatives remain unsupported.
JAX run_cart_relax is a no-pack ramp, not FastRelax.
No public JAX fragment decomposition/recombination.

Canonical PDB/Biotite loading consumes the complete shared canonical metadata and rejects unknown atom names. Explicit ResidueBlock input supports arbitrary prepared residue identities and parameter contexts. General CIF/ligand preparation/selection adapters remain absent. PDB output derives elements from the chemical database, including Zn/Fe, and preserves coordinate precision until text formatting.
